title: Correlation Clustering of Bird Sounds
description: Code for the paper "Correlation Clustering of Bird Sounds" by David Stein and Bjoern Andres (GCPR 2023): training of siamese and classification networks on spectrograms of xeno-canto recordings, and correlation clustering of bird sound recordings by greedy additive edge contraction and Kernighan-Lin, and the experiments of the paper.

creators.name: Stein, David
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Computer Science, TU Dresden, Germany
